title: Adley Rutschman could make his Red Sox debut in coming days
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adley Rutschman, 28, acquired from the Orioles, could debut for the Red Sox Tuesday in Toronto.
Rutschman completed two rehab games with Triple-A Worcester after recovering from wrist inflammation.
Red Sox manager Chad Tracy stated Rutschman's play depends on his assessment after a workout Monday.

title: Healey signs bill allowing state to take Norwood Hospital through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Gov. Maura Healey signed a bill to enable the state to seize Norwood Hospital via eminent domain.
The state can transfer or lease the seized property to a nonprofit entity to continue construction as a healthcare facility.
Norwood Hospital has been closed and construction stalled since a 2020 flood; former operator Steward Health Care filed for bankruptcy.

title: Dozens displaced by building collapse in Springfield
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A severe thunderstorm caused a building collapse on Dwight St. Ext. in Springfield, displacing 45 residents.
Mayor Domenic Sarno declared a state of emergency following widespread power outages and damage from the storm.
The Red Cross is aiding displaced residents, while Eversource sent crews to restore power from Connecticut.

title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adam Vinatieri was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, celebrating his 24-year NFL career.
Vinatieri joked about Bill Belichick and Deflategate during his Hall of Fame speech in Canton, Ohio.
He expressed gratitude towards Robert Kraft and praised New England Patriots fans for their support.

title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 7-year-old was fatally struck by a vehicle while biking in Williamstown at Main Street and Buxton Hill Road.
The child, wearing a helmet, entered Main Street unintentionally and died at the scene from their injuries.
The driver was not impaired, and no arrests or charges have been made; the incident is under investigation.

title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials warn residents to keep pets away from Ames Pond after a dog's death possibly linked to an algae bloom.
Ames Pond beach undergoes weekly testing; no E. Coli issues found, but cyanobacterial algae blooms are suspected.
Algae blooms can cause rapid illness in humans and be fatal to pets, prompting continued water safety monitoring by officials.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Former NH State Trooper James Lamoureux decertified for misleading police about placing GPS devices on vehicles.
Lamoureux received a deferred six-month sentence for making false reports, pleading guilty in Keene District Court.
He will resign from the police force and be listed on the national registry of decertified officers.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Police responded to Grace Chapel in Lexington after reports of a man with a gun, later deemed no threat.
The man was polishing a powder horn, a gunpowder container, while waiting for his wife, causing public concern.
Lexington police confirmed he is an avid reenactor and the heavy police presence was precautionary.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts Red Sox will make playoffs despite team's impressive winning streaks.
Red Sox currently hold the second A.L. wild-card spot with a 64-52 record.
FanGraphs gives Red Sox 96% chance of playoffs, 83.4% for a wild-card spot.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was a late scratch from Saturday's Red Sox lineup due to leg swelling from a hit on Friday.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return to the lineup Sunday after receiving more treatment.
Abreu leads the team with 20 home runs and 62 RBIs, posting a .256 average and .793 OPS in 2026.
